scope: A reviewed starting map for Marketing PhD job seekers across Quant / Modeling, Consumer Behavior and Strategy, with separate Economics / IO complements. Not an exhaustive directory or market census.
limitations: Resource relevance is not a person-level research classification.
An access attempt does not refresh person evidence.
Survey respondent totals do not enter placement denominators.
Reference-directory size does not establish cohort completeness; defined populations require separate roster evidence. Job coverage is not globally exhaustive.
